backend.mode: CatDetectionMode.faceOnly on two preregistered spatial ROIs
backend.runtime_platform: GitHub-hosted Ubuntu Linux desktop integration test under xvfb
backend.model_weight_hashes: computed in CI from the exact pinned checkout

pilot_001_hugging_full_rate.timing: authoritative decoded PTS ledger, not header FPS
pilot_001_hugging_full_rate.identity_anchor: sampled contact-sheet review before full-rate probe; tabby remains left/foreground and black cat right/background in the short source
pilot_001_hugging_full_rate.duplicate_face_guard: if both ROI channels return face centers closer than 8 percent of full-frame diagonal, identity for that frame is REVIEW rather than PASS candidate
pilot_001_hugging_full_rate.reason: The first full-mode probe produced two valid faces in only 3 of 6 sampled frames because the body detector sometimes omitted one cat. The face landmark model itself returned valid 48-point geometry whenever a face was localized. Fixed spatial ROIs test the face-localizer/landmark stage directly without silently treating body-detection failure as landmark failure.

required_before_admission: exact Fast-CAT head/tree identity rather than GitHub PR merge pseudo-ref
independent validation of landmark accuracy on reviewed frames or a justified benchmark transfer
separate CatFACS-compatible action-onset evidence with previous action-absent decoded frame

claim_ceiling: This backend may generate candidate 48-point geometry for review and model development. ROI identity and finite points are not ground truth and cannot by themselves establish PILOT_001 landmarks_48, facial_action_onset, delta_t, or INDEPENDENT_FRAME_LEVEL_ESTIMATE.
